user_saw: Copied and downloaded Markdown transcripts showed speaker headings with no text beneath them, even when the entire conversation had no exportable text.
summary: The shared Markdown formatter now skips records with empty or whitespace-only text and reports an empty export when no text remains.
reasoning: The formatter already appended headings for empty extracted text before the July Control UI refactor, and the August copy menu reused that behavior. The full-history path search stopped at a missing object before the shallow boundary, so I could not verify whether the original export shipped with the defect or an earlier change introduced it.
